<!-- Generated by npm run generate. Do not edit. -->

Every mounted HTTP method is extracted from `src/main.rs`. **Implemented** means the router has a handler, not that every model/provider supports it. Placeholder status is after authentication and successful body/query extraction; malformed or unauthenticated requests can fail earlier. No undocumented OpenAI endpoints are implied.
